summary_notes: Q1 2026 results beat on EPS and revenue, strong YoY net income and operating cash flow growth. Catalysts: reinstatement of Tia Maria project exploitation permit in Peru (resolves long-standing regulatory uncertainty); copper prices near record highs on supply disruptions; new CEO appointment, enhanced dividends/higher payouts; Cuajone mine $318.6M upgrade plan. SCCO moved +4.00% on May 26, 2026. Note: one source mentions a May 5 earnings call reference and another references May 18 earnings slides; next earnings likely late July 2026 (Q2). Conflicting near-term dates in sources.
